Subject: Your divorce by mutual consent matter

Dear Ms. Shinde,

Thank you for meeting us on 16 February 2023 about your dispute with Simran Natarajan. As we understand it, the spouses agree on a single payment instead of maintenance. The matter is listed before the Family Court at Mysuru.

Our advice is to record the one-time alimony settlement in the consent terms. Please collect income tax returns and the draft consent terms and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
